title: Subjects
description: D102 (documentary plan, slice 2) — one pass over the WHOLE narration before any shot is planned: what the video is about on screen, the visual thread every shot should stay on, and the subjects the story returns to, each with its own searches. Written by the `subjects` stage; read by beat craft (each beat names its subject) and by resolve_assets (a shot's searches rotate through its beat's and its subject's queries).

main_idea.description: one sentence: what the whole video shows, in things a camera can see

visual_thread.description: keyword searches (at most 5 words) that fit almost any shot of this video — the fallback that keeps a generic span on the main idea

look.description: one line: what this subject looks like on screen

queries.description: keyword searches (at most 5 words), different ANGLES of the subject, most specific first

first_cut.description: the first cut index where the narration reaches this subject

youtube.description: D104 — one search for a video platform, where real footage of the actual place, event or person exists: it NAMES them ('Centralia mine fire 1962'), unlike `queries`, which are written for stock libraries that match generic words. Optional: gather_footage builds one from the video's recurring proper noun and the subject's name when it is absent.

hook_end_cut.description: the last cut index of the opening hook — read by the hook tier (slice 5)

title.description: a working title for the video
